metadata.content:
*Give the audience a surprise.*

| **Area, Magic** |                       **[Main action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|-----------------|--------------------------------------:|
| **📏 3 [burst](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/burst)**  | **🎯 Self and each ally in the area** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Presence](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/presence):**

- **≤11:** The target can [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) 1 square and make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike).
- **12-16:** The target can [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to 2 squares and make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) that gains an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge).
- **17+:** The target can [shift](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/shifting) up to 3 squares and make a [free strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.main-actions/free-strike) that gains an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge), then can spend a [Recovery](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/recoveries).
